Title: Karan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Karan - 36 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Ajay - 65 years, king, father
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
3. Meenakshi - 57 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Kavita - 28 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Karan stands in the court. Meenakshi, Ajay and Kavita stand near him.]

Ajay: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan unrolls the royal scroll and reads it aloud.]

Karan: "And then?"

[Karan drinks the poisoned wine and dies.]

Kavita: "Rest in peace."
